description: This file contains unit tests for the Person class in the OpenMRS project. It tests various methods related to person attributes, addresses, names, and age calculations, using JUnit 5 and Hamcrest matchers.

classes.name: PersonTest
classes.description: Test class for testing the Person class methods and behaviors

methods.name: shouldAddRemoveAddress
methods.description: Tests adding and removing addresses from a Person object, including handling duplicates and voided addresses.

methods.name: shouldAddRemoveName
methods.description: Tests adding and removing names from a Person object, including handling duplicates and voided names.

methods.name: shouldAddRemoveAttribute
methods.description: Tests adding and removing attributes from a Person object, including handling duplicates and voided attributes.

methods.name: shouldSetInexactBirthdateFromAge
methods.description: Verifies setting birthdate based on age and ensuring the birthdate is estimated.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeAfterBirthday
methods.description: Tests calculating age after the birthday has occurred.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeBeforeBirthday
methods.description: Tests calculating age before the birthday occurs in the year.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeOnBirthdayWithMinutesDefined
methods.description: Tests age calculation on the birthday when birth time is set with specific minutes.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeOnBirthdayWithNoMinutesDefined
methods.description: Tests age calculation on the birthday with no specific birth time minutes.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeAfterDeath
methods.description: Verifies that age returned is correct when the person is marked dead and death date is set.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeWithGivenDateAfterDeath
methods.description: Verifies age calculation with a reference date after death.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeWithGivenDateBeforeDeath
methods.description: Verifies age calculation with a reference date before death.

methods.name: getAge_shouldGetAgeWithGivenDateBeforeBirth
methods.description: Verifies age calculation with a reference date before birthdate.

methods.name: addAttribute_shouldNotSaveAnAttributeWithABlankStringValue
methods.description: Ensures attributes with blank string values are not added to the person.

methods.name: addAttribute_shouldNotSaveAnAttributeWithANullValue
methods.description: Ensures attributes with null values are not added.

methods.name: addAttribute_shouldVoidOldAttributeWhenANullOrBlankStringValueIsAdded
methods.description: Checks that adding an attribute with null or blank value voids previous attribute of same type.

methods.name: shouldSetDeadToTrueIfSetDeathdate
methods.description: Verifies that setting a death date marks the person as dead.

methods.name: getAgeInMonths_shouldReturnCorrectAgeInMonths
methods.description: Tests age in months calculation relative to birthdate.

methods.name: getAgeInWeeks_shouldReturnCorrectAgeInWeeks
methods.description: Tests age in weeks calculation based on birthdate.

methods.name: getAgeInDays_shouldReturnCorrectAgeInDays
methods.description: Tests age in days calculation based on birthdate.

methods.name: getAgeInMonths_shouldReturnNullIfBirthdateIsNull
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when birthdate is not set for age in months.

methods.name: getAgeInMonths_shouldReturnCorrectAgeIfDeathDateIsBeforeCurrentDate
methods.description: Checks age in months when death date is before current date.

methods.name: getAgeInWeeks_shouldReturnCorrectAgeIfDeathDateIsBeforeCurrentDate
methods.description: Checks age in weeks when death date precedes current date.

methods.name: getAgeInDays_shouldReturnCorrectAgeIfDeathDateIsBeforeCurrentDate
methods.description: Checks age in days when death date is before current date.
